Dose: 100 mcg / 0.5 mL
Route: Intramuscular

3. Adverse Event Narrative
A 53-year-old female received Dose 1 of mRNA-1273 (Spikevax) on 14 January 2025. Approximately 11 day(s) following vaccination, the patient developed symptoms consistent with Anaphylaxis. The patient sought medical attention and was treated in the emergency department. The outcome was recovered with sequelae. The reporter does not consider the event related to mRNA-1273 vaccination.
